sentences.text:
Lovekush @ Shaktiman Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.
Home Lko. on 10 April, 2024

Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:29412
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 2654 of 2023
Applicant :- Lovekush @ Shaktiman Verma

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhaker Prakash,Amit Bhardwaj
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.185 of 2022, under Section 498A, 304B Ipc &
Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Boundi, District Bahraich.

entities.text: D.P. Act, P.S. Boundi, District Bahraich
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant around five years ago and sufficient dowry was given.
Subsequently, the daughter of the informant was hanged to death by the applicant.
The cause of death as per the postmortem report, is ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, only one abraded contusion was found on the eye.

4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
Lovekush @ Shaktiman Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Lovekush @ Shaktiman Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Considering the post-mortem report and the fact that there is no allegation that soon before the death, the victim was subjected to any mental or physical harassment in relation to demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 04.07.2022, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Lovekush @ Shaktiman Verma be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 10.4.2024 nishant  Lovekush @ Shaktiman Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
